citation: Metro Mernda line: turn-up-and-go peak Metro frequency (published PTV timetable). If a metro trunk line doesn't clear 'decent', the route frequency curve is miscalibrated.

SmartBus orbital 901 (Frankston - Melbourne Airport): a 7-day, high-catchment orbital route. High circuity is intrinsic to an orbital's job -- if it lands 'stranded' the directness weight/curve is wrong, not the route.
SmartBus orbital 903 (Mordialloc - Altona): same orbital-directness caveat as 901.
Real school-special service (Bannockburn - Geelong Station, 2 weekday trips): a known school_special=true route. Should stay out of league tables and not score as a turn-up-and-go trunk route.
Emerald - Fountain Gate SC: real hourly outer feeder route (published PTV timetable, ~6 weekday trips). Should not score above a low-mid band.
